title: Instructor
description: Educational instructor or teacher profile with expertise areas, course count, student enrollment, ratings, experience, and certifications. Used for online learning platforms, educational institutions, and training programs.

expertise.description: Array of subjects or topics the instructor teaches (e.g., Programming, Design, Business)

courses_count.description: Total number of courses taught by this instructor

students_count.description: Total number of students enrolled in this instructor's courses

rating.description: Average student rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

years_experience.description: Number of years of teaching or professional experience

certifications.description: Array of professional certifications or qualifications
